checks: P, b, k, g_max non-decreasing M6..M24; dk_max equal for M16 and M20 (32.8) in all sources (standard table), then 38.8 for M24
dk_max > d, k < dk_max, g_max < k in every row; countersink angle 90 deg for M6-M16 and 60 deg for M20/M24 in all clusters
shape_hint: Flat countersunk-head bolt with a small rectangular nib (tab) on the underside of the countersunk head that bites into the part to stop the bolt turning: head is a shallow cone of diameter dk, height k and included angle alpha (90 or 60 deg), the nib protrudes by height g under the cone; below it a plain shank with thread of length b for a nut.
notes: DIN 604 only (nib type). Same family also covers DIN 605 (square neck, M6-M10), DIN 608 (short square neck, M10-M12) and ASME B18.9 plow bolts (inch) -- not tabulated. Angle: 90 deg for M6-M16, 60 deg for M20 and M24. dk of M16 and M20 are both 32.8 in the standard table as published by 3 independent sources.

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched fuller, kova, capital, fasteners.eu, theo, fastenerdata, wikipedia live (200). Matrix 7 rows (M6-M24) x 6 value columns (P,b,dk_max,k,g,alpha) x 6 sources: no disagreement except theo's mislabelled last row (values of M20 under 'M24') and fastenerdata dk (nominal 12,16,19,24,32,32). Clusters (min over rows): P 3 (fuller, kova/capital, fasteners.eu; no other DIN 604 page lists P), b 4, dk_max 3 for M20/M24 (fuller, kova, feu; theo stops at M16), k 4, alpha_min 3 for M20/M24 (fuller, kova, fastenerdata; fasteners.eu prints angle without per-size alignment), g 4. Legend of fasteners.eu read: 'g - width of the nib', 'i - height of the nose', 'k - head height', 'alpha - angle head'.
problems: g_max role is WRONG in the record: producer labels it nib HEIGHT ('돌기 높이', role_map 'nib height max', shape_hint 'nib protrudes by height g'); the only legend (fasteners.eu) says g = WIDTH of the nib and i = HEIGHT of the nose; fuller calls the same row 's'. Numbers are 4-cluster verified but the role was inferred -> drop g_max (or relabel as nib width g and fix shape_hint)
k label: record says 'nominal' but fuller prints 'k max' and the other pages bare 'k' -> relabel '머리 높이 k' without 호칭
P has exactly 3 clusters (fuller, kova=capital, fasteners.eu); dk_max M20/M24 and alpha_min M20/M24 also exactly 3
M16 and M20 dk_max both 32.8: confirmed by fuller, kova/capital, fasteners.eu (+theo M16); consistent with 60 deg cone on M20 ((32.8-20)/2/tan30 = 11.1 ~ k 11.5)
Family label 'KS B 1017 · DIN 604 · DIN 605 · DIN 608 · ASME B18.9' and name '사각목·돌기붙이': table is DIN 604 (NIB type) only - square-neck DIN 605/608 and ASME plow bolts are not covered
alpha_min: only min angle (90 deg / 60 deg; max 95/65 deg not published)
